name: 現在地と地図の位置指定
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Correct ONE small detail of LH01-0006. Image1 is generated candidate; image2 ORIGINAL controls fine-detail geometry/alignment/spacing and icons; image3 rough Japanese mock is secondary copy only.
ONLY change the horizontal row divider: its left end must start exactly under the left edge of the two Japanese text labels, leaving the entire left icon column white and uninterrupted. Like the original source, the separator must NOT touch the card's left border and must NOT pass beneath the icon column. It ends at the right inset margin. Keep a faint thin neutral hairline.
Preserve everything else: two rows "現在地を使用" then "地図上で選択", Meiryo Regular14/24 tracking0 delicate weight; original filled blue #2176D9 concave navigation arrow for real current-location meaning, original filled slate #526173 pin with white hole, white #FFFFFF card/canvas, soft border/shadow, existing geometry, icons and margins. No mint circles, additional controls, wording or states. Original source remains higher priority than mock for icon geometry and fine details. Landscape3:1 flat frontal UI.
reviewNotes: 原参照優先の矢印・地点ピンと日本語2行を保持し区切り線を本文の左端までインセット修正。現在地のみ意味のある青、地図指定はスレート。白面、ミント円なし、余計な操作なし、欠けなしを目視。静止画像のエージェントレビューのみで所有者承認・厳密フォント一致・編集可能性・実装は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
